messages:
Maya: Heads up — drafting release notes for release v2026.03.1. Planning internal blast and a DeployBot run tomorrow 04:00–05:30 UTC. Need the RN blurb, canary owners, and explicit rollback criteria.
Jack: I can own the canary monitoring. Draft blurb suggestion: 'Performance and routing fixes; defaults tuned for lower tail latency.'
Sabrina: Add explicit rollback criteria in the RN please. Recommend: 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 10m OR p95 latency > 800ms over 5m.
Maya: Added those. For ops-run instructions include immediate revert command: `./ops rollback --to v2026.02.9` and the escalation path to oncall.
DeployBot: Scheduled deploy queued by @Maya for 2026-03-15 04:00 UTC. CLI preview: `/deploy run release/v2026.03.1 --canary=10% --stagger=10m --notify=#eng-oncall`
Eli: Quick Q — are we pinning the model version in the RN? Prod services will need the model pin to avoid surprises.
Jack: Yes — pin to `distill-llama-13b-q4_0`. Also add a fallback note: if GPU availability constrains capacity, fallback to `distill-13b-fp16`.
Maya: Draft RN internal snippet: 'Rolling out serving-runtime optimizations and routing updates. Canary rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m staggers. Pinned model: distill-llama-13b-q4_0 (fallback distill-13b-fp16). Rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.5% sustained 10m OR p95 > 800ms over 5m. Revert command: `./ops rollback --to v2026.02.9`.'
Sabrina: LGTM. I'll prepare the internal announcement and ops checklist. Will send T-2h before the deploy. @Jack please confirm DeployBot will emit heartbeat updates to #eng-oncall and post canary progression messages.
Jack: Confirmed. DeployBot will post start/complete/heartbeat and percent progression. I'll be watching the dashboards and will escalate on first sign of regression. :eyes:
Maya: Final step — review the RN doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/placeholder. If no objections, I'll publish the internal blast at 02:00 UTC and trigger the scheduled deploy.
notes: short thread; ops coordination, pinning, rollback criteria, and DeployBot timing discussed
